paired.note: hold is a legitimate permanent outcome — the two books may never separate
paired.paired_note: paired days are those BOTH arms advanced independently; the seeded prefix is a copy of production history in both arms and cannot differ
paired.counts_as_new_trial_note: a switch would be a NEW trial: re-run scripts/prereg.py with trials.this_trial+1 before adopting the candidate

provenance.convention: adjusted-close basis; two REPLAY arms of the frozen D-track rule set on the same data slice and universe; the only difference is the stop width (flat 3.5% vs ATR 1.0 clipped to [2.5%, 4.0%]); intraday stops evaluated on minute bars, close rebalance at the panel close; T+1; no leverage
